name: Tovuti
description_en:
Tovuti LMS is a hosted training platform combining course delivery, learning paths, automated assignments, role-based access and reporting. It supports internal teams and external learning audiences.

The product family also includes WayPoints AI authoring and managed LMS services. A base platform price should not be treated as the price of every optional authoring or operating service.
description_zh:
Tovuti LMS 是托管培训平台，结合课程交付、学习路径、自动分配、角色访问及报告，面向内部团队和外部学习人群。

产品家族还包括 WayPoints AI 创作及托管 LMS 服务，基础平台价不代表包含所有可选创作或运营服务。

core_features.explanation_en: Assign structured training and inspect completion reports.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分配结构化培训并查看完成报告。

core_features.explanation_en: The platform lists H5P content, instructor-led events and mobile learning.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台列出 H5P、讲师活动和移动学习。

core_features.explanation_en: Operational services and WayPoints are separate scoped add-ons.
core_features.explanation_zh: 运营服务与 WayPoints 为另行约定的附加项。

use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starts at $7,500/year for 100 annual learners; larger counts and optional managed services/WayPoints require a scoped quote.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 100 名年度学员起价每年 7,500 美元；更多人数及托管服务、WayPoints 需按范围报价。

sources.title: Create Courses, Engage Learners & Train Teams | Tovuti LMS Software
sources.research_notes_en: Read learning delivery, roles, integrations and distinction between LMS, WayPoints and services.

sources.title: How Much Does an LMS Cost? | Tovuti LMS Pricing
sources.research_notes_en: Read $7,500 annual/100 learner base, standard functions, scaling and optional scoped services/AI add-ons.

official_check.scope: Public official documentation research; no account, purchase, live workflow, performance, owner identity or publication approval verified.

review_notes: Original English research and corresponding Chinese translation by Codex AI; vendor documentation is not independent product testing.
Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: The official pages describe learning paths, H5P interactive content, certificates, events/instructor-led learning, ecommerce and dashboards. HRIS/CRM and identity connections support learner administration. Standards-based content is advertised, but a particular package and completion rule still need a pilot. WayPoints is separately named as standalone AI course authoring.
sections.zh: 官方页面介绍学习路径、H5P 交互内容、证书、活动及讲师课程、电商和仪表板，HRIS/CRM 与身份连接支持学员管理。虽然宣传标准内容支持，具体内容包及完成规则仍需试点。WayPoints 另外命名为独立 AI 创课产品。

sections.en: Create a pilot path with a video, interactive check and assessment, assign it to a test employee group and compare reports with expected completions. Include a learner who fails or resumes later. If syncing an HRIS, verify account creation and deactivation separately from course completion. This is a suggested workflow, not an actual Tovuti integration test.
sections.zh: 创建含视频、交互检查和考核的试点路径，分配给测试员工组，并把报告与预期完成对照。加入失败或稍后恢复的学员。若连接 HRIS，应把账户创建、停用与课程完成分开验证。本例不是实际集成测试。

sections.title_en: Annual learner pricing with optional services
sections.title_zh: 年度学员计价及可选服务
sections.en: The pricing page lists the full platform from $7,500/year for the first 100 annual learners and says pricing scales with learners. Listed standard functions include authoring, reports, commerce, mobile/offline and integrations. It separately labels LMS-as-a-Service and WayPoints AI as optional add-ons priced to scope. Confirm the contractual learner definition, additional-user rate, implementation and any discount before estimating a larger population; the 100-user price is not an unlimited enterprise quote.
sections.zh: 定价页列完整平台起价每年 7,500 美元，对应前 100 名年度学员，并随人数扩展。标准功能列出创作、报告、电商、移动离线及集成，另把 LMS-as-a-Service 和 WayPoints AI 标为按范围定价的可选附加项。扩大人数预算前需确认合同学员定义、增员费、实施及折扣；百人价格不是无限企业报价。

sections.title_en: Check the real package and contract
sections.title_zh: 检查实际内容包与合同
sections.en: Start with a demonstration using your intended content and report criteria, then verify permission boundaries and exports. Vendor statements about government/security status should be evaluated against the exact environment and procurement contract; this review did not validate certification. Tovuti may fit repeatable training programs, but does not prove learning effectiveness or compliance by enrollment alone. Source licensing, restoration and offline-sync limits remain unverified.
sections.zh: 先用目标内容和报告条件做演示，再确认权限边界及导出。政府与安全状态宣传需对应具体环境和采购合同，本次未验证认证。它可用于重复培训，但仅登记学员不能证明学习有效或合规。源码许可、恢复及离线同步限制仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify annual learner definition, expansion rate, selected integrations, government-environment eligibility and offline/recovery behavior.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认年度学员定义、增员费、所选集成、政府环境资格及离线恢复行为。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
